questions.prompt: It is high time we _____ our study habits before the board exam.
questions.explanation: "It is high time + subject" takes the past simple verb (V2) to indicate urgent present action.

questions.prompt: Walk fast lest you _____ miss the morning class at Aloms English Center.
questions.explanation: "Lest" is always followed by "should" (or "might") + base verb without "not".

questions.prompt: Neither the teacher nor the students _____ absent yesterday.
questions.explanation: With "neither...nor", the verb agrees with the nearer subject ("students" -> plural "were").

questions.prompt: He is _____ honest man in our neighborhood.
questions.explanation: The "h" in "honest" is silent, so it begins with a vowel sound and takes "an".

questions.prompt: No sooner had the bell rung _____ the students entered the hall.
questions.explanation: The correlative pair is "No sooner had ... than".

exams.title: HSC Modifiers, Prepositions & Connectors Live Test

questions.prompt: Bangladesh is famous _____ its hospitality and natural beauty.
questions.explanation: "Famous for" is the standard collocation for being well-known because of something.

questions.prompt: The boy _____ in the front row is my younger brother. (Use participle post-modifier)
questions.explanation: A present participle phrase ("sitting in the front row") post-modifies "The boy".

questions.prompt: _____ he worked very hard, he could not finish the essay on time.
questions.explanation: "Although" introduces a contrast between hard work and not finishing on time.

questions.prompt: She insisted _____ going to the Mirpur campus seminar.
questions.explanation: The verb "insist" takes the preposition "on" followed by a gerund.

exams.title: IELTS Band 8 Academic Vocabulary & Reading Drill

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to "ubiquitous" in academic writing?
questions.explanation: "Ubiquitous" means present, appearing, or found everywhere (omnipresent).

questions.prompt: Choose the best formal verb to replace "make smaller" in Task 1:
questions.explanation: "Diminish" accurately conveys decreasing or becoming smaller in data descriptions.

options: The statement directly contradicts the passage
There is insufficient information in the passage to confirm or deny the claim
The keyword appears in the final paragraph
questions.explanation: NOT GIVEN applies when the passage does not contain information verifying or contradicting the statement.

questionBank.subject: HSC English 2nd Paper
questionBank.prompt: It is high time we ___ our preparation for HSC English Final.
questionBank.explanation: After "It is high time + subject", the verb always takes the past simple form.

questionBank.subject: HSC English 2nd Paper
questionBank.prompt: Had I possessed the required vocabulary, I ___ Band 8 easily.
questionBank.explanation: Inverted 3rd Conditional ("Had + S + V3") pairs with "would have + V3".

questionBank.subject: SSC English
questionBank.prompt: Let us revise the modifiers chapter together, ___?
questionBank.explanation: Sentences starting with "Let us / Let's" take "shall we?" as tag question.

questionBank.subject: SSC English
questionBank.prompt: Aloms English Center students are accustomed ___ speaking fluently.
questionBank.explanation: "Accustomed to" is followed by a gerund (V+ing).

questionBank.subject: IELTS & Spoken
questionBank.prompt: Choose the closest synonym for "ubiquitous" in Academic Reading:
questionBank.explanation: Ubiquitous means present or found everywhere (omnipresent).

questionBank.subject: Grammar Pro
questionBank.prompt: Neither the branch manager nor the teachers ___ absent today.
questionBank.explanation: With "Neither...nor", the verb agrees with the nearer plural noun ("teachers").
